description:
Fanjingshan Xueya, 'Fanjing Mountain snow bud', is a green tea name from the Fanjing Mountain area of Tongren in Guizhou. Very little is documented about it, and it is not clear whether it is a distinct regional style or a grade name used by certain producers.

The word xueya usually signals a bud-heavy green tea. If this one follows the pattern, expect tender early-spring leaf, gently handled and dried, with a light and fresh cup.

Treat it like other tender greens: cool the water and keep the leaf from stewing. Those are general rules for the style rather than knowledge about this particular tea.

The better-documented tea of the area is Fanjingshan tea, the regional name with Cuifeng as its top green style. If you see Xueya for sale, ask who made it and when it was picked.
